description.en: Your private notebook for videos, articles and posts: ideas, work in progress and published, with steps to tick off and a target date. Nothing is ever shown on your site.
description.fr: Votre cahier privé pour vos vidéos, articles et posts : idées, en préparation et publié, avec des étapes à cocher et une date visée. Rien n'est jamais montré sur votre site.

help.fr: Une étape par ligne (12 au plus). Laissez vide pour : Script, Miniature, Description, Publication. Les idées déjà notées ne changent pas : vous pouvez modifier leurs étapes une par une.
help.en: One step per line (12 at most). Leave empty for: Script, Thumbnail, Description, Publishing. Ideas you already wrote down do not change: you can edit their steps one by one.

help.fr: Un repère pour vous, jamais une obligation. Si vous publiez moins que prévu, le cahier vous le dit tout doucement.
help.en: A guide for you, never a duty. If you publish less than planned, the notebook tells you very gently.

settings.default: YouTube, Twitch, Instagram, TikTok, Blog, Newsletter, Podcast, Bluesky

help.fr: Séparés par des virgules (12 au plus). Ce ne sont que des suggestions : dans une idée, vous pouvez toujours en écrire d'autres.
help.en: Separated by commas (12 at most). These are only suggestions: in an idea you can always write others.

addLabel.fr: Ajouter un rythme (par exemple une vidéo par semaine)
addLabel.en: Add a rhythm (for example one video per week)

help.fr: Le fichier contient toutes les idées, notes comprises.
help.en: The file holds every idea, notes included.

mcp.name: ideas_list
mcp.description: List the ideas of the content notebook (videos, articles, posts), newest planning first. Each item has its id, title, one-line summary, place (idea, doing, published or archived), steps with done flags, target date and networks. Use it to find an idea before moving it or ticking a step. Pagination: pass back the returned next as cursor.

place.description: Which ideas: idea = not started, doing = in progress, published, archived, active = idea + doing + published (default), all.

q.description: Words to look for in titles, summaries, notes, networks and steps (accents and capitals are ignored).

cursor.description: The next value of the previous answer, to read the following ideas.

mcp.name: idea_get
mcp.description: Read one idea of the content notebook in full, notes included.

id.description: The idea id, as returned by ideas_list.

mcp.name: idea_add
mcp.description: Write down a new idea in the content notebook. Only the title is required; the steps come from the owner's default model unless you give some. The idea is private: it is never shown on the website.

title.description: Short title of the video, article or post.

place.description: Where to put it: idea (default) or doing (in progress).

networks.description: Networks concerned, for example YouTube, Twitch, Blog (12 at most).

steps.description: Steps to tick off, in order (12 at most). Leave out to use the default steps.

mcp.name: idea_update
mcp.description: Change the title, summary, target date, networks or notes of an idea. Only the fields you give are changed; give targetDate as an empty string to remove the date. Does not move the idea (use idea_move) and does not tick steps (use idea_step).

targetDate.description: New target date as YYYY-MM-DD, or an empty string to remove it.

networks.description: The full new list of networks (replaces the old one).

mcp.name: idea_move
mcp.description: Move an idea between the places of the notebook: idea (not started), doing (in progress), published, or archived (put away, never deleted). Moving to published records today as the publication date. Moving out of archived puts the idea back in the place you give.

to.description: The place to move the idea to.

mcp.name: idea_step
mcp.description: Tick (or untick) one step of an idea, for example the script or the thumbnail. Give the step name as written in the idea, or its number (1 = first step).

step.description: The step name (capitals ignored) or its number, 1 for the first step.

done.description: true to tick (default), false to untick.
